upgrade_path: Two DDR5 SO-DIMM slots support up to 32GB of replaceable RAM (DDR5-4800), and the M.2 NVMe SSD storage is expandable. The discrete GPU is soldered and not upgradeable.

description: The HP OMEN 16 (2022, AMD) is the AMD-powered 16.1-inch gaming laptop, pairing AMD Ryzen 6000 H-series processors with either an all-AMD Radeon RX 6650M or NVIDIA RTX 30-series graphics. With high-refresh display options and upgradeable internals, it delivers strong multi-core and gaming performance, including an all-AMD configuration option.
upgrade_path: Two DDR5 SO-DIMM slots support up to 32GB of replaceable RAM (DDR5-4800), and the M.2 NVMe SSD storage is expandable. The discrete GPU is soldered and not upgradeable.

description: The HP Envy x360 15 (2022, Intel) is a 15.6-inch convertible 2-in-1 built on Intel 12th-generation processors, with Iris Xe or optional NVIDIA RTX 2050 graphics. Its 360-degree touch hinge, upgradeable memory, and Active Pen support make it a flexible everyday laptop for work, study, and media.
upgrade_path: Two DDR4 SO-DIMM slots support up to 32GB of replaceable RAM, and the M.2 NVMe SSD can be swapped for larger or faster storage.

description: The Asus ROG Zephyrus Duo 16 (2026) is a flagship dual-screen gaming and creation laptop, the world's first 16-inch dual-screen gaming notebook. It pairs an Intel Core Ultra 9 (Panther Lake) processor with up to an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 Laptop GPU, dual 16-inch ROG Nebula HDR OLED displays, and a detachable full-size keyboard. Its memory is soldered.
upgrade_path: RAM is soldered to the mainboard (LPDDR5x) and cannot be upgraded, so choose the RAM at purchase. The Gen5 M.2 NVMe SSD is replaceable, so storage is the main upgrade path. The discrete GPU is soldered.

description: The Asus ROG Strix Scar 18 (2026) is an 18-inch flagship gaming laptop built on an Intel Core Ultra 9 HX processor with up to an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 Laptop GPU and a large power budget for sustained performance. It features a 4K Mini-LED display (the world's first 4K 240Hz Mini-LED laptop panel) and, unusually for a flagship, fully user-upgradeable memory and storage.
upgrade_path: Highly serviceable: two DDR5 SO-DIMM slots support up to 128GB of replaceable RAM (DDR5-6400), and two M.2 NVMe SSD slots allow up to 8TB of storage. The discrete GPU is soldered and not upgradeable.

description: The Asus ROG Zephyrus G16 (2026) is a thin-and-light 16-inch gaming and creator laptop built on an Intel Core Ultra 9 (Panther Lake) processor with up to an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 Laptop GPU. It pairs serious performance with a premium aluminum chassis under 1.5cm thick, a 240Hz 16:10 OLED display, and Slash Lighting. Its memory is soldered.
upgrade_path: RAM is soldered to the mainboard (LPDDR5x) and cannot be upgraded, so choose the RAM at purchase. The M.2 NVMe SSD is replaceable, so storage is the main upgrade path. The discrete GPU is soldered.

description: The Asus ProArt P16 (2026) is a 16-inch creator laptop built on an AMD Ryzen AI 9 HX 370 processor with a 50 TOPS NPU and up to an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 Laptop GPU. It features a 4K OLED PANTONE-validated touchscreen with stylus support (with a 120Hz HDR panel on higher configurations), tuned for content creation, color-critical work, and AI workloads. Its memory is soldered.
upgrade_path: RAM is soldered to the mainboard (64GB LPDDR5X) and cannot be upgraded. Storage is expandable via two M.2 NVMe PCIe 4.0 slots (one used on the base configuration, both on the top configuration). The discrete GPU is soldered.
